[23/11/2026, 13:00] Victor: Hi, I'm in Seattle, buying the Galaxy S23 for my mum in Kakamega. Is it the 256GB green one?
[23/11/2026, 13:08] Lucy: Hi Victor. Yes, 256GB, green, no scratches. $430
[23/11/2026, 13:10] Victor: Ok $430 works
[23/11/2026, 13:12] Victor: Can you send by Easy Coach to Kakamega?
[23/11/2026, 13:15] Lucy: Yes. I'll book it on Easy Coach on 25/11/2026
She can collect at their Kakamega office
[23/11/2026, 13:16] Victor: Great. Is the charger included?
[23/11/2026, 13:18] Lucy: Only the cable, no charging brick
[23/11/2026, 13:19] Victor: That's fine
notes: Diaspora buyer in USD; Easy Coach parcel counts as courier even though recipient collects at the office; absolute ship date.
